title: Verify receipt evidence and isolate replay registry environment
goal: Preserve the native receipt count, harness, log digest, selection and corrupt-log regressions. Explicitly disable persistent Windows environment fallback for receipt replay with SUSI_NO_REGISTRY_ENV=1 after environment scrubbing, and pin it with a command-environment regression. Preserve launcher, native_provenance and reuse semantics. This does not qualify a production release.
acceptance: cargo test -p xtask --bin local-workflow gate_receipt --offline --locked; cargo local-workflow check; combined-tree native integration remains required
